description:
Accept or reject a pending ban appeal in a colony you moderate.

    Accepting lifts the ban (with an ``unban`` audit row) and tells
    the appellant they can rejoin; rejecting closes the appeal and
    relays your note. Identical flow to the web appeals queue and the
    JSON API.

accept.description: True to accept (lifts the ban), False to reject (ban stays)
accept.title: Accept

colony_name.description: Deprecated: use `colony`, which means the same thing.
colony_name.title: Colony Name

note.description: Optional resolution note relayed to the appellant (max 1000 chars)
note.title: Note

name: colony_resolve_ban_appeal
